name: @bini/cloud
description: BINI PMS v4 Firebase cloud foundation with a DEV Hosting preview (not operational PMS).

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-bini-v4 "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.build:prod: npm run build -w packages/shared -w packages/functions && npm run build:prod -w packages/web
scripts.deploy:dev:hosting: npm run guard:dev && npm run build && npm run guard:hosting-package && firebase deploy --only hosting --project bini-transient-dev
scripts.deploy:dev:firestore: npm run guard:dev && npm run test:rules && firebase deploy --only firestore --project bini-transient-dev
scripts.deploy:dev:functions: npm run guard:dev && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run guard:functions-package && firebase deploy --only functions --project bini-transient-dev --force
scripts.deploy:prod:firestore: npm run guard:prod && npm run test:rules && node scripts/deploy-prod.mjs firestore
scripts.deploy:prod:functions: npm run guard:prod && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run guard:functions-package && node scripts/deploy-prod.mjs functions
scripts.deploy:prod:hosting: npm run guard:prod && npm run build:prod && node scripts/assert-hosting-package.mjs --target=prod && node scripts/deploy-prod.mjs hosting
